identity.title: C-SDLC v2 publish cannot represent non-closing incremental parent checkpoints

values.task_boundary: Add one typed publication linkage mode and carry it through publication, observation, evidence, and finish.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: closing mode preserves current exact closing-keyword behavior
AC-2: part_of accepts only an exact non-closing Part of reference
AC-3: split-authority part_of references are repository-qualified
AC-4: mixed, ambiguous, or mismatched linkage fails closed
AC-5: intent, remote observation, and publication evidence retain linkage_mode
AC-6: finish cannot close or terminalize an issue from part_of evidence
AC-7: omitted mode remains compatible as closing
dependencies: Current C-SDLC v2 publication and finish contracts
